name: Special City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING

To the Members of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates:

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a special meeting of the City Council to
take place at City Hall, 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA at 8:00 a.m. on
Friday, December 28, 2012 for the purpose of holding a closed session. The agenda for the special
meeting with the items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below.

Posted by the City Clerk on December 26, 2012, at 4:30 p.m.

  December 28, 2012
  8:00 A.M.
  Council Chambers of City Hall
  340 Palos Verdes Dr. West
  Palos Verdes Estates

  AGENDA
  OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry
concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet, if any, can be
made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the
Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, prior to the
meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however,
to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a
presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is
requested to fill out a green speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The
card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please
see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The
City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order
of items shown on the agenda.

COUNCIL AGENDA
SPECIAL MEETING
December 28, 2012
  1
 CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEM(S)

CLOSED SESSION

This time has been set aside for the City Council to meet in a closed session to discuss the
matters listed below pursuant to Government Code Pursuant to Government Code 54957. The
Mayor or City Attorney will give an additional oral report regarding the closed session.

Pursuant to Government Code section 54957
PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT
Title: City Manager

RECONVENE IN OPEN SESSION

CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT

At the conclusion of the Closed Session, the Council may continue any item listed on the closed
session agenda to the Open Session agenda for discussion or to take formal action as it may
deem appropriate.

ADJOURNMENT TO WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 9, 2013 IN COUNCIL CHAMBERS OF
CITY HALL FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR MEETING.

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing
agenda was posted not less than 24 hours prior to the meeting on the City Hall Bulletin Boards
located by front door and inside adjacent to Council Chambers located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive
West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, Palos Verdes Golf Club, and Malaga Cove Library,
delivered to each Councilmember and sent to each media outlet that has requested such notices, in
accordance with Government Code Section 54956. Dated this 26th day of December, 2012.

  Vickie Kroneberger, CMC
  Executive Assistant/Deputy City Clerk

COUNCIL AGENDA
